✨ hyperframes | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Generating MP4 videos from HTML and CSS code, particularly for use by AI agents to automate video creation.
✨ Key Features: • HTML to Video Rendering • CSS Styling Support • Seekable Animations • CLI Tool • AI Agent Integration (Skills)
📖 Summary: HyperFrames is an open-source framework that converts HTML, CSS, and animations into MP4 videos. It's designed for use with AI coding agents, local CLI, and as a rendering core for authoring workflows.
